name: Oath of Devotion
summary: The classic shining knight sworn to honesty, courage and mercy.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.short: Oath spells that are always prepared for free.
features.summary: You always have your oath spells prepared once you reach the listed paladin levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon
features.short: Add CHA to attack rolls with a glowing weapon for a minute.
features.summary: As an action, imbue one weapon you hold: for 1 minute you add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to attack rolls with it, and it sheds bright light.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Unholy
features.short: Turn fiends and undead within 30 ft.
features.summary: As an action, each fiend or undead within 30 ft. that can see or hear you makes a WIS save or is turned for 1 minute.

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.short: You and allies within 10 ft. can't be charmed.
features.summary: You and friendly creatures within 10 ft. can't be charmed while you are conscious. The range becomes 30 ft. at 18th level.

features.name: Purity of Spirit
features.short: Always protected from evil and good.
features.summary: You are always under the effects of a Protection from Evil and Good spell.

grants.text: Always under Protection from Evil and Good.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.short: Radiate light that burns enemies for 10 radiant each turn.
features.summary: As an action, for 1 minute you emanate bright light in a 30 ft. radius. Enemies starting their turn in it take 10 radiant damage, and you have advantage on saves against spells cast by fiends or undead. Once per long rest.
